hypothesis: Determine whether the observed all-false predicate collapse is a universal Boolean-format limitation, and whether explicitly grounding the schema in the prompt changes simple structured output.

basis.observed: All eight source-predicate responses set evidence_sufficient false even when prose noticed real changes.
basis.paraphrase: The official guide suggests providing a schema through format and also including its string form in the prompt.

prompt: Read the supplied synthetic data and return ONLY the requested JSON object. same is whether left equals right; different is whether left differs from right; flag copies the input Boolean exactly; total adds the two integers; marker copies the exact input string. Do not add explanations, fields or external knowledge.
arm_order: Forward for positive case, reverse for negative case.
interpretation_limits: A literal/arithmetic calibration is not source-comprehension or bilingual-document accuracy.
Passing a true-valued Boolean disproves a universal cannot-emit-true claim, not semantic reliability.
Any observed prompt effect is development diagnosis, not neural learning or independent holdout.
No production prompt, routing or model is changed.
